Servicios y trámites de seguridad privada

items.title: Private security is Freematica's largest segment
items.summary: zvoove acquired Freematica on 5 September 2024 to enter Spain, lead in private security and gain a first foothold in the Americas (offices in Mexico and Colombia); private security is Freematica's largest business segment.
items.implication: Security is a distinct domain with its own regulation, conventions and field operations, not a staffing variant.

items.title: Security ERP value is claimed in scheduling, payroll and incident reduction
items.summary: Freematica claims 33% less scheduling time, 40% fewer payroll and billing errors and 70% fewer incidents reported by clients or audits; 600+ security and auxiliary companies use e-Satellite.
items.implication: Scheduling hours, payroll/billing error rates and client-reported incidents are the adoption KPIs.

items.title: Spanish market scale
items.summary: APROSER reports sector revenue of EUR 4,918 million in 2023 (+6.4%), 89,750 active security guards (95% on permanent contracts) and a split of 59% guarding, 34% systems and alarms, 7% cash transport; 76% of business comes from the private sector.
items.implication: Guarding is labour-intensive with permanent staff: payroll and rostering dominate cost.

items.title: Colombia is a large, regulated guarding market
items.summary: Colombia's superintendent of surveillance cited about 1,500 surveillance companies and 348,300 guards, supervised by Supervigilancia.
items.implication: Country packs for regulator reporting and local payroll are prerequisites for LatAm growth.

items.title: Authority audits require licence and service evidence
items.summary: Spanish private-security activity is authorised and supervised by the Policía Nacional; e-Satellite generates automatic reports for Segurpri audits and connects via open APIs.
items.implication: Licence tracking and audit packs are core, not add-ons.

items.title: A global consolidator dominates guard-tour software
items.summary: Trackforce, combining TrackTik, GuardTek and Silvertrac, reports 4,600+ customers in 50+ countries and 55+ languages.
items.implication: Large multinational guarding firms may standardise globally; Freematica differentiates on Spanish-speaking regulation, convenio payroll and ERP depth.

items.title: Clients expect portal access to service validations
items.summary: e-Satellite offers a client portal with secure access to documentation and service validations.
items.implication: Client transparency reduces disputes and supports renewals.

items.title: zvoove positions personal security as one of three core industries
items.summary: zvoove.com describes the group as a provider of software and AI solutions for temporary staffing, cleaning services and personal security.
items.implication: Security can reuse group capabilities (payroll engine patterns, AI platform, WFM from Planbition, which also serves security firms).
